spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (नखति)
To move.

mn. (-खः-खी)
A finger nail.
m. (-खः)
A part, a portion.
nf. (-खं-खी)
A perfume, a dried substance, of a brown colour, and of the shape of a nail; apparently, a dried shell fish, used as a perfume.
f. (-खी)
A vegetable perfume, different from the one above, though known by the same name, NAKHI.
E.
न privative, ख sense; or नह to bind, ख Uṇādi affix, the radical ह rejected.

m. (-ट्टः)
A barber.
E.
नख a nail, and कुट्ट who cuts; barbers in India trim the nails, &c.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Who or what eats with nails or talons.
E.
नस्व, and खादिन् eating.

m. (-णः)
A falcon.
E.
नख a nail, and दारण tearing.

n. (-दं)
A scratch, the mark of a finger nail.
E.
नख, and पद a mark.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Torn, or torn off with a nail.
E.
नख, and भिन्न divided.

m. (-चः)
A bow.
E.
नख a nail, मुच to let loose, क aff.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
What scalds the nail.
E.
नख, and पच to cook, खश aff.

m. (-रः)
A finger nail.
f. (-री)
A perfume: see नस्वी.
E.
न not, खन to go, and डर affix; or नख a nail, रा to go or be, affix ड.

f. (-नी)
A nail-parer.
E.
नख, and रञ्जनी beautifying.

m. (-धः)
1 A lion.
2 Any beast of prey.
3 A cock.
E.
नखर a nail, आयुध a weapon.

f. (-खा)
A scratch.
E.
नख, and लेखा a line.

m. (-खः)
A scratch.
E.
नख, and विलेखा a mark.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
What tears or rends, (as a bird of prey, &c.)
E.
नख, and विष्किर what scatters.

n. (-णं)
A scratch.
E.
नख, and व्रण a wound.

m. (-ङ्खः)
A small shell.
E.
नख a nail, शङ्ख a shell, one as small as a nail.

m. (-शुः)
Elegance of the finger nails.
E.
नख, and अंशु a ray.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A scratch, a mark of the nail.
2 A sort of perfume.
E.
नख a nail, and अङ्क a mark.

m. (-धः)
1 A tiger.
2 A lion.
3 A cock.
4 Any beast or bird having talons.
E.
नख, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-लिः)
A small shell.
E.
नख a nail, and आलि a line; also नखालिका.

m. (-शी)
An owl.
E.
नख a nail, and अशिन् who eats, using its claws in feeding.

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
Nailed, clawed, having nails or talons.
E.
नख, and इनि aff.
